author: gap-fill
review_scope: Single AI author reads the selected entry and its default key in context, then records positional polyphone decisions. The word was chosen from the jieba missing-common-word checklist. This is not an independent human linguistic review and not a bulk import.
pronunciation_dependency: pypinyin 0.55.0 authoring-only; default agreement is not a review decision
frequency_policy: Fixed coarse project-relative category bands before native evaluation; no measured corpus frequencies or tuning to public answer ranks.
source_policy: The entry was selected from the jieba frequency checklist (dict.txt, MIT), not from a bulk import and not from tests/data. Existing entries and weights were not modified.
